revision_note: 2026-08-14 user-confirmed full frozen-Baseline SAM2 masks. Latent cells are partitioned by exact nonempty object-membership signature (R_A, R_B, R_AB, ...); M1 deletes only each signature's self block. A 3-case seed-47326 All-time implementation pilot precedes every denoising-window run.
objective: Localize when, along the 40-step denoising trajectory, full-visible-object membership-signature M1 and full-object-union M2/M3 contributions in latest3350 Top100 and Bottom100 heads are necessary for object trajectory, identity/survival, and background stability.

scope_boundary.interpretation: Stage 5 varies denoising step window only; it does not test latent-video temporal direction or cross-object edge necessity.

object_partition.mask_source: frozen seed-matched Baseline SAM2 masks at latent anchors F00,F04,...,F48
object_partition.cell_membership: an object is present in a 22x40 latent cell iff any mask pixel intersects that cell
object_partition.object_sets: R_S contains exactly the latent cells whose nonempty object-membership signature is S; all R_S are mutually exclusive
object_partition.shared_tokens: shared cells remain distinct signatures such as R_AB and R_ABC rather than being assigned to one object
object_partition.cross_object_guardrail: all R_S<->R_T edges for S!=T remain unchanged for M1/M2/M3
object_partition.single_object_degeneracy: when m=1, the definitions reduce exactly to the prior single-object M1/M2/M3

denoising_windows.naming_guardrail: Use step-quartile labels until the exact scheduler timestep and sigma arrays are audited. High-noise/low-noise labels are allowed only after monotonicity is verified.
scheduler_audit: save all 40 scheduler indices, timesteps, sigmas, next_sigmas, and delta_sigmas
verify identical arrays across every task
report exact sigma range and integrated delta-sigma for every window
denoising_windows.sensitivity_analysis: If equal-step and equal-delta-sigma boundaries differ materially, retain equal-step windows as primary and add equal-delta-sigma windows only as a labeled sensitivity analysis.

analysis_strata.object_endpoints: compute per object, then report within-video macro mean and worst object separately

compute_matrix.formula: 30 joint target-seed units x 2 head scopes x 3 flows x 4 windows
compute_matrix.all_time_reuse_condition: only the one-object case may reuse prior single-object Wall after exact real-GPU equivalence; every multi-object Wall must be rerun because prior all_objects also removed cross-object edges
compute_matrix.baseline_policy: generate the missing exact baseline before outcome analysis; never substitute another seed

rationale_from_stage3_dose_percent.interpretation: Historical Stage3 exploratory shares only. Stage3 used per-object/union targets rather than the revised block-diagonal target, so these values motivate tentative directions but are not dose estimates for Stage5. Baseline-path passive dose must be recomputed under the new mask before interpretation.

H5_M1.if: M1 R-to-R necessity is concentrated later in denoising
H5_M1.then: W3 will change target identity more than W0 for the same head scope
H5_M1.falsification: case-level effects are mixed or the interval includes effects smaller than the MDE

H5_M2.if: Top100 M2 C-to-R necessity is concentrated earlier in denoising while Bottom100 M2 is approximately flat
H5_M2.then: Top100 W0 will change target trajectory more than W3, and its W0-minus-W3 contrast will exceed the Bottom100 negative-control contrast
H5_M2.falsification: Top100 case-level effects are mixed or the Head-by-Window interaction does not distinguish the Top100 gradient from Bottom100

H5_M3.if: M3 object-to-global-background necessity is concentrated earlier in denoising
H5_M3.then: W0 will change the frozen global-background context more than W3 for the same head scope
H5_M3.falsification: eligible-case effects are mixed, coverage is inadequate, or the interval includes effects smaller than 0.02 LPIPS

hypotheses.head_by_window_interaction: For each flow, compare the planned window contrast in Top100 against the same contrast in Bottom100. This tests stage-dependent head-group selectivity rather than a raw Top-vs-Bottom mean.

primary_test_family.composition: six within-head planned early/late contrasts plus three Top100-minus-Bottom100 window-interaction contrasts
primary_test_family.middle_windows: W1/W2 are secondary shape and monotonic-trend diagnostics, not additional primary pairwise tests
primary_test_family.power_boundary: The maximum independent n is 10 cases. MDEs define practically meaningful effects but are not guaranteed-detectable effects. If uncertainty includes effects smaller than the MDE, report insufficient evidence rather than equivalence.

dose_policy.interpretation: The Stage 5A estimand is natural-dose necessity: it combines contribution availability and network sensitivity. Outcome/dose division is forbidden. Realized applied dose is post-treatment-path data and is not a valid sole causal adjustment covariate.
dose_policy.baseline_path_probe: Mandatory passive no-op capture of potential attention mass, removed-value norm, and removed/output ratio for every target, head scope, flow, and window; report separately from applied intervention dose.

matched_dose_followup.label: Stage5B_discovery_sensitivity
matched_dose_followup.trigger: A Stage5A primary Head/Window contrast reaches its MDE and its corresponding passive potential-dose ratio lies outside [0.8, 1.25].
matched_dose_followup.method: Before observing Stage5B outcomes, freeze alpha <= 1 from the Baseline passive path so both contrast sides are reduced to the smaller potential removed-value norm; never amplify alpha above 1.
matched_dose_followup.interpretation: Tests whether the Stage5A direction survives approximate dose matching. It is not part of the nine-test primary family and does not justify outcome/dose division.

aggregation_and_missingness.within_case_order: pair exact case-seed-joint_target cells; compute object endpoints per object and retain macro and worst summaries separately; then average seeds within case and weight cases equally
aggregation_and_missingness.trajectory_hurdle: report gate-failure/track-loss on all pairs and ADE/FDE only on paired gate-pass observations
aggregation_and_missingness.missing_policy: never impute missing trajectories, masks, GT, or failed tracks as zero
aggregation_and_missingness.coverage_policy: report cases, case-seeds, target pairs, gate failures, and finite pairs for every contrast

reporting_grid.primary: Within each head and flow, planned W0-vs-W3 contrast on the flow-specific endpoint; plus the corresponding Top100-vs-Bottom100 window interaction.
secondary: W0/W1/W2/W3 curve shape within fixed Head and Flow
Top100-vs-Bottom100 within fixed Flow and Window across trajectory, identity/survival, and propagation metrics
M1-vs-M2-vs-M3 within fixed Head and Window across the same metric
each window vs Wall on raw outcome and survival metrics
reporting_grid.exploratory_only: Head-by-Flow-by-Window 24-cell profiles; maximum independent n is 10 and does not support a strong three-way mechanistic claim.
reporting_grid.non_additivity_guardrail: Do not sum windowed final-video outcomes or express them as a causal percentage of Wall.

implementation_gates: W0/W1/W2/W3 are disjoint and their union is exactly steps 0 through 39
membership-signature sets R_S are mutually exclusive after tokenization and C_bg is exactly the complement of their union
M1 deletion mask equals the union of signature diagonal blocks and contains zero R_S-to-R_T entries for every S not equal T
M2 and M3 use only C_bg as context and preserve every cross-signature edge
outside the active window the attention output is identical to the unmodified path for the same forward inputs
for one fixed forward input the four removed contribution tensors sum to Wall within frozen tolerance; final video effects are not assumed additive
each 100-head window task has exactly 100 x 10 x 2 = 2000 modified head-step-CFG events
each selected head has exactly 10 x 2 = 20 active events and zero modified events outside its window
both CFG branches are covered and recorded separately
empty-window no-op matches Baseline within deterministic tolerance
on the one-object case, new-code M1/M2/M3 Wall matches the prior single-object All-time implementation on a real-GPU smoke before its limited reuse
all videos decode to 49 frames and all manifests, active masks, doses, and metric reports are readable
stopping_rules: stop before the matrix if scheduler order or sigma metadata is inconsistent
stop if object token sets overlap, their union/complement is inconsistent, or any cross-object edge is removed
stop if no-op or Wall equivalence fails
stop if any task modifies a step outside its declared window
stop if exact case-seed Baseline is missing
stop outcome aggregation if duplicate experiment keys or configuration hashes conflict
do not stop early or choose windows based on interim outcome values
